title: Benchmarking Cascading Robustness Verification's efficiency claims on open models

original_idea.body: Benchmarking Cascading Robustness Verification (arXiv:2602.04236) on a small open classifier; reproduce runtime/coverage Pareto with cheap-then-expensive verifier cascade.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cheaper verification aids auditing but adversarial-robustness certification's link to catastrophic AI risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: MNIST/CIFAR-scale with existing verification tooling; some verification-domain knowledge needed but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused runtime/coverage Pareto plot; implementing the cascade adds a workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Auditing tooling, open models, weak lab incentive; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Toy classifiers on a consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Reproduction/benchmarking of a recent method on new classifiers; partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent method; reproduction on safety-adjacent classifiers may be open.
